title: feat(core,vue): add onSelectionChange and onSlashMenuChange config callbacks

commits.message:
feat(core,vue): add onSelectionChange and onSlashMenuChange config callbacks

Add onSelectionChange and onSlashMenuChange to EditorConfig, mirroring the
existing onChange/onFocus/onBlur pattern. Previously these events were only
accessible via the event emitter.

- core/types: add onSelectionChange? and onSlashMenuChange? to EditorConfig
- core/editor: wire callbacks alongside emitter.emit calls
- core/test/events.test: 5 new tests (cursor move, selection, coexistence)
- vue/editor: expose as props + emits, bridge config callbacks to Vue events
- vue/test/editor-vue.test: 2 new tests for Vue emit behavior

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
